docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform role at Halden Pay. I have built and operated data systems across payments and freight, and I am particularly interested in the role’s focus on a shared platform that enables analysts, data scientists and product teams rather than one-off pipelines.

At Lukovac Freight Hub, I own ingestion and orchestration across Airflow, Snowflake, dbt and Kafka. I designed a shipment-event pipeline handling around 30 million events per day, with end-to-end latency under two minutes at p95, and added dead-letter and replay tooling to support reliable recovery. I also replaced hourly full-table extracts with Debezium CDC, reducing replica CPU during loads from approximately 70% to 25%. These projects have involved operating production pipelines and improving the platform as its users and needs grow.

Earlier, at Kovalent Pay, I built PySpark reconciliation jobs matching bank settlement files against internal ledgers. They reduced the finance team’s manual month-end reconciliation from about three days to about four hours. That experience is one reason I value accurate, timely data in payments. I would bring to Halden Pay hands-on experience with Python, SQL, AWS data services, warehouse optimization, dbt, Airflow and open-source tools, alongside a practical focus on reliability and maintainability.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my data platform experience could contribute to Halden Pay’s Data Platform team.

Kind regards,
Lena Varga-Holm
